description: Official NVIDIA two-Spark profile: exact b9ce18a6 checkpoint and measured eugr b12x image 03a95654. TP2, 262,144-token window, 16 streams, FP8 KV, shared PLE tables, four-token MTP and RoCE all-reduce. Controller supplies placement and fabric identities. Memory is a conservative per-node estimate, not a local measurement. Publication does not establish physical Spark qualification.
title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next FP4-Local vLLM dual Spark (NVIDIA)
